type Intersect<A, B, C> = A & B & C;
const one: Intersect<boolean, any, undefined> = 1;
const two: Intersect<boolean, any, void> = 2;
const three: Intersect<true, any, null> = 3;
const four: Intersect<false, null, any> = 4;
const five: Intersect<boolean, any, string> = 5;
const six: Intersect<number, any, boolean> = 6;
const seven: Intersect<boolean, null, object> = 7;
const eight: Intersect<boolean, null, unknown> = 8;
const nine: Intersect<false, true, any> = 9;
const ten: Intersect<undefined, null, any> = 10;
